# @bangbang93/opencode-edit-error-recovery

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that stops the model from retrying a failed `edit` against its own idea of the file.

When `edit` fails because the text is not in the file, matches more than once or would change nothing, a reminder is
appended to the error. It tells the model to read the file, find where its assumption was wrong, tell the user about
the failed edit, and only then edit again.

## Install

Add the package to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["@bangbang93/opencode-edit-error-recovery@0.1.0"]
}
```

To run a checkout of the repository instead, point the entry at `packages/edit-error-recovery`.

## Behavior

- Only failed `edit` calls are touched. The error keeps its text, and the reminder follows it after a blank line under
  the heading `[edit-error-recovery]`.
- The reminder is added when `oldString` is not found, when it matches more than once without `replaceAll`, and when
  the edit would change nothing.
- Every other failure keeps its message, for example a missing file or a denied permission.

## Disable

Add `"-edit-error-recovery"` to the `plugins` array.

## License

MIT. [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md) lists what this plugin derives from.

# Notice

This plugin re-implements the edit-error-recovery hook of
[oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) 5.1.24 for the OpenCode V2 plugin API.

## Sources

- Hook design: `packages/omo-opencode/src/hooks/edit-error-recovery/hook.ts` of oh-my-openagent 5.1.24, commit
  `fda8eb83630682c22a18e06b51b7366f843858b9` (Sustainable Use License v1.0). No source text from that package is
  included here.

## Differences from the oh-my-openagent hook

- Built on `ctx.tool.hook("execute.after")`. OpenCode 2.4 reports a failed `edit` as an error instead of as the tool's
  output, so the reminder is appended to the error's message.
- Failures are recognized by fragments of the OpenCode 2.4 messages: `oldString` not found, several matches without
  `replaceAll`, and every `No changes to apply` error. The last group is wider than the original's check for identical
  strings, because OpenCode 2.4 also reports an edit that would leave the file unchanged this way.
- The reminder is reworded.

## Dependencies

- `@opencode/plugin` must stay compatible with the OpenCode release that loads the plugin.

## Disable

Add `"-edit-error-recovery"` to the `plugins` array in `opencode.jsonc`.
